item.title: Marvelous Profits Skyrocket 1,105% Thanks to Overseas Game Sales
item.description: Japanese video game publisher Marvelous has reported a massive 1,105% increase in operating profit, with strong overseas sales of titles such as Story of Seasons: Grand Bazaar and Moonlight Peaks helping the company return its gaming division to profitability.

item.title: Former Adult Actress Mao Hamasaki Hospitalized After Suspected Drugging
item.description: Former Japanese adult film actress Mao Hamasaki was rushed to a hospital in Hong Kong after allegedly consuming a drugged drink while working as a DJ, suffering convulsions and hallucinations before being admitted to intensive care.

item.title: Shokugeki no Soma Artist Shun Saeki Ends Exclusive Contract With Shueisha
item.description: Shun Saeki, the Japanese manga artist best known for illustrating Food Wars! Shokugeki no Soma, has announced that his long-standing exclusive contract with manga publisher Shueisha has officially ended, revealing that he is now seeking new professional opportunities.

item.title: Hagure Idol: Jigoku-hen Reportedly Getting Uncensored Anime in 2027
item.description: The sexually explicit martial arts manga Hagure Idol: Jigoku-hen (Booty Royale: Never Go Down Without a Fight!) is reportedly receiving a television anime adaptation in 2027, complete with an uncensored version that could preserve some of the original series’ notoriously revealing content.

item.title: Persona 1 Remake Gameplay Footage Allegedly Leaks Online
item.description: Nearly two minutes of gameplay footage allegedly showing an unannounced remake of the original Persona have leaked online, sparking speculation that Atlus is preparing to revive another classic entry in its popular RPG franchise.

item.title: SEGA Removes Amy Rose’s Love for Sonic From Official Character Bio
item.description: SEGA has rewritten Amy Rose’s official character biography, removing references to her romantic feelings for Sonic and her longstanding desire to become his girlfriend, and even removing this trait on the Japanese version of the biography.

item.title: Hello Kitty Cancels Vivant Collaboration After China Backlash
item.description: Japanese entertainment company Sanrio has abruptly canceled its collaboration between Hello Kitty and the hit television drama Vivant, following criticism from Chinese state media over scenes depicting Chinese intelligence agents brutally torturing Japanese operatives.

item.title: Resident Evil Director Frustrated by Fans Complaining About Changes to Games
item.description: Resident Evil director Zach Cregger has expressed frustration over the reception to his video game adaptation, arguing that much of the discussion surrounding the film focused on its differences from the original games rather than the movie itself.

item.title: Dragon Ball Creator Akira Toriyama’s Home & Bird Studio Being Demolished
item.description: The former home and workplace of legendary Dragon Ball creator Akira Toriyama is being demolished in Japan, with photographs of the building undergoing construction work sparking sadness among fans of the late manga artist.

item.title: Japan’s Shibuya Locks Down for Halloween With Police & Alcohol Restrictions
item.description: Tokyo’s Shibuya district has introduced extensive security measures for Halloween 2026, deploying hundreds of police officers, restricting alcohol sales, and barricading its famous Hachiko statue as authorities prepare for large crowds of costumed visitors.

item.title: Former Adult Actress Sora Aoi Warns Women Against Entering Industry
item.description: Former Japanese adult film actress Sora Aoi has revealed that she actively discourages young women from entering the adult entertainment industry, warning that its potentially lifelong consequences outweigh the glamour and financial opportunities often associated with the profession.

item.title: Showa American Story Director Rejects Changing Cultural References in Localization
item.description: The director of Showa American Story, an upcoming action RPG from Chinese developer NEKCOM Games, has criticized the practice of replacing cultural references during localization, arguing that international audiences should be allowed to experience a game’s original cultural identity.

item.title: Honkai: Star Rail Leakers Ordered to Pay $150,000 in Damages
item.description: Two individuals responsible for leaking unreleased Honkai: Star Rail content have been ordered to pay approximately $150,000 in damages to developer miHoYo, following a court ruling that determined their actions violated the company’s trade secrets.

item.title: Japanese Farmer Sentenced to Six & a Half Years for Burning Down Pakistani Mosque
item.description: A 37-year-old Japanese farmer has been sentenced to six years and six months in prison for setting fire to a Pakistani-owned mosque in Hokkaido, admitting that he wanted to drive Pakistanis out of Japan.

item.title: Japan’s Used Anime Merchandise Is Booming Overseas, Mercari Reveals
item.description: Japanese online marketplace Mercari has revealed that overseas demand for secondhand Japanese merchandise has skyrocketed, with international transactions growing approximately 19-fold in just four years, driven partly by the worldwide popularity of anime, manga, and video games.
